summary: Web application called 'HarvestSync' that coordinates perishable crop harvests between farmers, buyers, and logistics providers with three user roles (Farmer, Buyer, Transporter) and a landing page. Uses green-and-white Agri-tech aesthetic with Tailwind CSS. Core goal: enable Pre-Harvest Commitments to reduce spoilage. Planning to add four AI/ML features: predictive analytics for yield/price forecasting, computer vision for crop maturity detection, logistics optimization algorithms, and NLP for voice/text input parsing.
architectural_notes: Three distinct user roles: Farmer, Buyer, Transporter
Tailwind CSS for styling with green-and-white color scheme
Focus on perishable crop coordination workflow
Smart Escrow Payment system for Pre-Harvest Commitments
Harvest filtering by village variation and quality certificates
Transport offer acceptance and tracking visible to Buyers and Farmers
Transport offers should link to specific buyer commitments chosen by farmer
Once a commitment is linked to a transport offer, it should not appear in selection again
Buyers can post demand requests specifying crop type, quantity, price per kg, and destination
Farmers should see buyer demand requests and be able to accept them
known_issues: Buyer commitments not displaying in Buyer dashboard after Pre-Harvest Commitment is made
Offer Transport button not working when commitments have been made
